title: Ejecutivo/a de cuentas y operaciones Brazil
description:
Oportunidad profesional Latin Xplore Brasil !
Latin Xplore, agencia receptiva mayorista B2B y empresa hermana de Go West Tours (DMC USA), que tiene oficinas en Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Argentina, Brazil y Chile esta buscando su Ejecutivo de Cuentas y operaciones en nuestra oficina de Rio, Brasil.
Su misión va desde el establecimiento de itinerarios, la reelaboración de estos dentro de los presupuestos del cliente, la contratación, la facturación y la organización de los grupos y FITs, así como la asistencia en la organización de la A a la Z de los diferentes tours.
Puesto : Ejecutivo de Cuentas y Operaciones
Lugar: Bureau de Latin Xplore à Rio, Brasil
Descripción del Puesto
- Estar en contacto con los Tour Operadores, las agencias de viajes de Europa para responder a los pedidos de viajes y producciones para sus clientes
-Realizar cotizaciones de los viajes y elaboración de producciones
- Negociar con los proveedores para estar competitivos, mejorar las tarifas de compra y las márgenes, con la ayuda del Gerente General
-Desarrollar la facturación de la cartera de clientes: mantenimiento de relaciones con clientes existentes y desarollo con nuevos clientes, fidelizar, mantener el vínculo con las cuentas clave,
-Trabajo comercial con posible participación en ferias, seguimiento de los files, relanzas,
-Coordinación con de las operaciones. Cumplir, cuando sea necesario, con tareas de operación (reservar hoteles, guías, restaurantes, transfers, excursiones).
- Manejar las distintas herramientas de comercialización y trabajo : Travel Exchange, Toursys, Excel
Competencias Técnicas Requeridas:
• Dominio Avanzado de Herramientas Informáticas: Excelente competencia en Microsoft Office, especialmente en Excel para cotizaciones, Word para la redacción de documentos. Canva sería una ventaja.
• Experiencia Profesional en Turismo: Experiencia significativa en una agencia de viajes o en una agencia receptiva, con una comprensión profunda de las operaciones y la logística del turismo, así como del mercado B2B.
• Conocimiento del Terreno de Brasil : Un conocimiento profundo de los principales destinos turísticos, las regulaciones locales y las particularidades culturales, lo cual es esencial para la elaboración de propuestas de viaje a medida. El conocimiento de otros países como Argentina puede ser también una ventaja.
Competencias sociales y personales:
• Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad: Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios y gestionar eficazmente situaciones imprevistas, entusiasmo e inversión en una empresa en pleno crecimiento que coloca al ser humano en el centro de sus preocupaciones.
• Multitarea y gestión de la presión: Capacidad para gestionar simultáneamente varios proyectos y clientes mientras se cumplen plazos ajustados, garantizando una prestación de servicio eficiente y profesional.
• Competencias interpersonales y comunicación: Excelente habilidad para comunicarse, negociar y establecer relaciones duraderas con clientes y proveedores.
• Orientación al cliente: Compromiso para proporcionar un servicio al cliente excepcional, anticipar las necesidades de los clientes y proponer soluciones creativas y adaptadas. Rigor y sentido del detalle son cualidades que buscamos para estar lo más alineados posible con las especificaciones de nuestros clientes y nuestra carta de calidad.
Lo que ofrecemos:
• Un salario competitivo basado en la experiencia
• Contrato local con beneficios complementarios
• Entorno de trabajo híbrido, combinando oficina y teletrabajo
• Participación en un proyecto innovador y en plena expansión, con un excelente ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de crecimiento
Para presentar su candidatura, envíe su CV y una carta de presentación a , especificando en qué medida su experiencia y aptitudes se ajustan a los requisitos de este puesto. Esperamos darle la bienvenida a nuestro equipo y hacer de nuestra colaboración un éxito conjunto.

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling, and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion. You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentations, and motion graphics.

This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation, and smart use of modern tools and AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.


What you'll do

  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows, and content exploration.

  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail, and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. Our workflow is built for momentum — pairing great talent with streamlined processes, smart tech and a global, supportive team.


At SoCreative, you’ll have the chance to:

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a DevOps / Technical Support Engineer to support a development team working on the internationalization and maintenance of a large-scale e-commerce platform. The environment consists of a distributed microservices architecture deployed on on-premises Kubernetes clusters and virtual machines , requiring hands-on troubleshooting, deployment operations, and strong coordination with engineering teams and clients. This role is highly technical and involves active participation in English-speaking client meetings and collaboration across multiple teams.


Responsibilities

  • Support the development team responsible for translating and adapting a distributed microservices e-commerce platform.
  • Manage and troubleshoot Kubernetes microservice deployments using Helm charts.
  • Operate and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; diagnose and resolve failures in automated deployment processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Java and Python development teams to understand deployment requirements.
  • Troubleshoot client ecosystem tools based on Jenkins self-service pipelines.
  • Support backend technologies such as PostgreSQL and Kafka, handling configuration, connectivity, and integration issues.
  • Retrieve and analyze logs from Kubernetes pods and on-prem VMs using Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), and Jenkins logs.
  • Participate in English-speaking client meetings to gather requirements, clarify needs, and provide updates.
  • Manage work using a Kanban workflow.
  • Contribute to improvements in deployment processes, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting procedures.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and containerized deployments in on-premise environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, especially Jenkins.
  • Basic to intermediate experience with microservices written in Java and Python.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL and Kafka.
  • Ability to diagnose distributed system issues using logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools (Grafana, ELK, etc.).
  • Experience with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to participate confidently in English-speaking client meetings.
  • Experience with Agile/Kanban methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in complex environments.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting legacy systems built in Java.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with large enterprise e-commerce platforms.
  • Knowledge of networking, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash or Python.
  • Experience with Groovy for Jenkins Pipeline-as-Code.

title: Creative Production Lead
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

﻿

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we're blending technology and real-world expertise to empower small businesses across the U.S. like never before.


We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That's why we're on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and grow sustainably without the hassle.


The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it's no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations, drive leads, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can focus on what they do best.


Why We Need You

You have the eye. You can look at a website for five seconds and know whether it builds trust or destroys it. You see the logo that looks like a 2008 Fiverr special, the stock photo that screams "we didn't try," the typography that signals cheap. And it bothers you. Physically.


We're building a production team that creates websites, logos, and visual assets for 4,000+ local service businesses—contractors, plumbers, attorneys, HVAC companies. These businesses live or die by how professional they look online. Your job is to make sure everything we ship makes them look like the best option in their market.


As Creative Production Lead , you'll manage a team of designers who assemble websites from content, photos, and structured data. You're not just assigning tickets. You're inspecting work daily, catching the details that kill credibility, coaching your team to see what you see, and refusing to let "good enough" out the door.


You can also DO the work yourself. When a logo needs to be created or fixed, you're not waiting for someone else. When a layout isn't working, you can open the file and make it better. You lead by example because you're a designer first, manager second.


The Impact You'll Have

  • Quality is your obsession. You review completed work daily—not for completion, but for excellence. You catch the weak logo, the amateur photo crop, the layout that buries the CTA, the color palette that feels dated. Nothing ships unless it meets your standards.
  • You inspect, you coach, you elevate. You're providing specific feedback on real work: "This logo doesn't work because the type is fighting the icon." "This hero image undermines trust—the lighting looks fake." "This layout guides the eye away from what matters." You're building your team's taste through detailed critiques.
  • You stay fluid. What looked great two years ago looks tired today. You're constantly studying what's working across industries, updating standards, killing approaches that stopped converting. When you spot a pattern that works, you train the team on it immediately.
  • You execute when needed. Logo needs a refresh? You can do it. Layout falling apart? You fix it. You're not above the work—you're the best at it.
  • You run production, not a gallery. This is high-volume. Your team handles hundreds of sites and thousands of updates monthly. You understand that speed and quality aren't opposites—they require discipline, systems, and people who give a damn.


What We Really Need From You

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in visual design with a portfolio that demonstrates genuine taste—not just competence, but an eye for what converts vs. what just exists
  • 2+ years leading or managing a design team—you've held people to standards, given hard feedback, and developed talent
  • Hands-on execution skills: you can create and refine logos, fix layouts, improve visual hierarchy yourself
  • Production experience: you've worked in environments where volume mattered—agencies, e-commerce, high-output teams
  • Quality obsession: you reject work that's "fine" because fine doesn't win


What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Background in advertising, branding agencies, or e-commerce design
  • Experience with WordPress page builders (Elementor, WP Bakery, Divi, Gutenberg)—or willingness to learn fast
  • Understanding of conversion principles: what builds trust, what drives action
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems
  • Knowledge of SEO basics and how design choices impact performance


We'll teach you:

  • Our specific tools and workflows
  • WordPress/Elementor if you don't know them (you'll pick it up in a week)
  • Our brand guidelines and quality standards
  • The local service business landscape


What You'll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Salary: Competitive (based on experience and location)
  • Flexible work: 100% remote, core hours 8 AM – 5 PM EST for collaboration
  • Work-life balance: 15 vacation days + U.S. holidays
  • Growth path: This role leads to Director of Creative Production or VP of Creative. You'll build the team, the systems, and the culture.
  • Real impact: Your standards directly determine whether 17,000+ small businesses look like winners or also-rans.


Why Choose Us?

We're evolving from template-driven agency work to genuinely differentiated design. You'll build a team culture where craft matters, where mediocrity gets rejected, and where the work actually helps small businesses compete.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here—and your unique perspective helps us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health


Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role


Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered. This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.


We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.


⭐What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive


Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content


Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience


Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar


Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs


Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach


Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)


  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates



You’re a Great Fit If You…


  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines


⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed


Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis

  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.

  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Resumo da função:


Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
  • Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
  • Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
  • Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
  • Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
  • Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
  • Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
  • Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
  • Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
  • Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
  • Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio


Exigências do Cargo:

  • Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
  • Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
  • Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
  • Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;


Escolaridade mínima:


  • Ensino médio técnico completo


Qualificação A: antes do embarque:


  • Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
  • Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
  • Well Control IWCF – Level 3
  • Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

title: Analista de Dados
description:
A GP Strategies Corporation é um dos principais fornecedores mundiais de transformação de talentos. Ao oferecer soluções premiadas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento, ajudamos as organizações a se transformarem por meio de seu pessoal e a alcançarem mudanças significativas. A GP Strategies forneceu suas soluções inovadoras de consultoria, serviços de aprendizado e tecnologia de talentos para mais de 6.000 organizações em todo o mundo.

E, em poucas palavras, a GP Strategies é o nosso pessoal: uma extensa rede global de especialistas em aprendizado. Saiba mais em


Estamos procurando um Analista de Dados que será responsável por analisar, interpretar e transformar dados relacionados aos programas de treinamento corporativo em insights estratégicos, garantindo a tomada de decisão baseada em dados para otimização de processos, melhoria da experiência do participante e aumento da eficácia dos treinamentos, incluindo a mensuração do retorno sobre investimento .


Esquema de trabalho: Remoto.


Principais atividades:


  • Coletar, organizar e validar dados provenientes de plataformas de treinamento, LMS (Learning Management System), pesquisas de satisfação e indicadores de desempenho.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios avançados para monitoramento de KPIs (ex.: taxa de conclusão, engajamento, impacto no negócio).
  • Realizar análises preditivas e prescritivas para identificar tendências, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria nos programas de capacitação.
  • Calcular e analisar o ROI dos programas de treinamento, considerando custos, benefícios tangíveis e intangíveis, e impacto nos resultados do negócio.
  • Apoiar a definição de métricas e indicadores estratégicos para mensuração da eficácia e retorno dos treinamentos.
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados, propondo melhorias nos processos de coleta e integração.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) e linguagens de programação (SQL, Python, R) para análises avançadas.
  • Automatizar bases de dados com Power BI e Excel, de forma a otimizar o tempo de resposta
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas com insights claros e recomendações para stakeholders.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Formação superior em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em análise de dados, preferencialmente aplicada à área de Treinamentos ou RH.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados.
  • Desejável conhecimento avançado em SQL e linguagens de análise (Python ou R).
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística, análise preditiva e cálculo de ROI.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (desejável).


Desejável

  • Facilidade com números e capacidade de defender decisões com embasamento quantitativo.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de aplicativos simples para suporte a treinamentos (ex.: quizzes e dentre outros)
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à análise de dados e otimização de processos.


Com mais de 4.000 funcionários em mais de 30 países, a diversidade na GP Strategies é uma segunda natureza! Além de nossas localidades, nossa cultura se concentra no desempenho e gira em torno do respeito, da justiça e do trabalho colaborativo para atingir nossos objetivos. Apoiamos nossos funcionários, não importa quem sejam ou de onde venham, porque todos nós temos perspectivas e abordagens valiosas e exclusivas. É assim que nascem as grandes ideias, que nos permitem trabalhar de forma mais inteligente.


A GP Strategies tem o compromisso e o orgulho de ser um empregador de oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para emprego sem levar em conta raça, nacionalidade, gênero, idade, religião, deficiência, orientação sexual, status de veterano ou estado civil.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Data Scientist - Scheduling Optimization
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsabilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.

title: Supervisor (a) Responsabilidade Social

Responsável por supervisionar as atividades da área de Responsabilidade Social, garantindo a qualidade dos serviços prestados, o cumprimento da legislação aplicável e a execução dos projetos sociais alinhados ao planejamento estratégico da unidade.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Team development

Data-driven decision-making

Marketing insights

Collaborative mindset

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

About Us

We are leading, women-owned VC firm investing in visionary and diverse founders at the pre-seed and seed stages. We have backed 100+ startups globally, including unicorn-caliber companies, and are now making a rare strategic hire to help build the internal operating system of our boutique, technology-driven firm.


Role Overview

You will work directly with the Partners across AI, operations, and systems design to build scalable internal workflows, automate processes, and bring structure to how we manage information, pipeline, and priorities. This is a deep-work , systems-focused role — not sourcing or events.


What You’ll Do

AI-Enabled Workflow Design

  • Audit existing tools (email, Slack, Notion, Airtable, CRM) and identify friction points.
  • Build AI-powered workflows for deal triage, research, summarization, communication drafts, and meeting synthesis.
  • Treat AI as a practical force multiplier focused on clarity and reliability.


Systems, Structure & Knowledge Management

  • Build and maintain the firm’s operating spine using Airtable and other AI tools.
  • Create schemas, tagging systems, and playbooks for pipeline, portfolio, and stakeholder tracking.
  • Turn partner thinking into structured, searchable knowledge bases.


Automation & Integrations

  • Use tools like Zapier/Make and APIs to connect systems, reduce manual work, and keep data synchronized.
  • Maintain automations as tools and processes evolve.


Light Analytics & Reporting

  • Support Partners with insights for IC discussions, portfolio updates, and LP conversations.
  • Build simple dashboards or queries to answer recurring questions.


Special Projects

  • Own operational or strategic initiatives that increase Partner leverage (content engines, process codification, templates, checklists, event simplification).
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve.


Who You Are


AI-Native Builder

  • Uses AI in a structured way: workflows, prompts, systems thinking.
  • Knows when to rely on tools and when to think independently.


Systems-Minded

  • Naturally brings order to scattered information and undefined processes.
  • Enjoys turning chaos into documented flows usable by different work styles.


Independent Problem Solver

  • Takes vague problems and returns with structure, prototypes, and clear plans.
  • Communicates progress proactively and manages time autonomously.


Analytical & Clear Communicator

  • Understands trade-offs behind tools and workflows.
  • Writes concise, practical documentation for non-technical teammates.


Low-Ego, High-Ownership

  • Comfortable receiving direct feedback and driving adoption of new systems.


Qualifications

  • 2–7 years in operations, biz ops, product ops, RevOps, chief-of-staff, analytics, or similar roles in startups, tech, or investment firms.
  • Experience designing workflows/automations (Notion, Airtable, CRMs, Zapier/Make).
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to transform workflows.
  • Comfort with data work (spreadsheets, basic queries; bonus for APIs/scripting).
  • Strong written communication; ability to work remote-first with high reliability.


Growth Path

For the right person, this role leads to:

  • Owning internal operating system end-to-end.
  • Becoming the firm’s AI + systems leader.
  • Influencing how we run investments, portfolio support, and LP communication.

Progress will be measured by:

  • Systems that drive adoption and real usage.
  • Clear improvements in time saved and decision quality.
  • Ability to anticipate needs and build before things break.

title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.


Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil

A International Schools Partnership está comprometida com a segurança e o bem-estar de crianças e jovens. Todos os profissionais devem cumprir processos rigorosos de verificação de antecedentes referentes aos últimos 10 anos de experiência.


Compromisso com Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

A International Schools Partnership promove uma cultura inclusiva e acolhedora, contratando e desenvolvendo talentos independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, deficiência, neurodivergência ou origem socioeconômica. Encorajamos candidaturas de profissionais que compartilham nossos valores e desejam contribuir para o sucesso da organização.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

title: Especialista em Lean
description:

Essa posição liderará a conversão para uma organização enxuta, conduzindo a implementação de ferramentas como:

  • Desenvolver e implementar Value Stream Mapping (VSM), com planos de ação de melhoria contínua.
  • Criar e sustentar processos padronizados em toda a organização.
  • Implementar Shop Daily Management (SDM).
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em colaboração com gestores, supervisores, equipes e clientes, conduzindo projetos de produtividade, redução de desperdícios, eventos Kaizen e outras iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Facilitar a gestão diária Lean e promover a cultura Lean por meio de Gemba Walk, iniciativas de segurança, 5S e gestão visual.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria de processos e produtividade, tanto operacionais quanto transacionais, com foco em R&M.
  • Orientar e fornecer suporte à liderança das instalações quanto a princípios, metodologias e ferramentas Lean e/ou Six Sigma.
  • Manter comunicação eficaz com diferentes stakeholders para planejar atividades que atendam aos requisitos do negócio.

  • Ministrar treinamentos sobre Lean, conforme currículo interno.
  • Mentorar, influenciar e desenvolver futuros praticantes Lean.
  • Fornecer liderança necessária para promover mudanças e esforços de transformação Lean em todas as instalações de R&M designadas.


Pré-requisitos:


  • Bacharelado em Engenharia Industrial, Mecânica, de Produção ou Elétrica.
  • Mínimo de 3 a 5 anos de experiência em Lean Manufacturing como líder de melhoria contínua, lean lead, black belt ou função similar.
  • Experiência comprovada como facilitador de Kaizen.
  • Vivência prática com ferramentas: VSM, 5S, 5Porquês, TPM, Trabalho Padrão, Poka-Yoke, SIPOC, Mapeamento de Processos, Kanban, SMED, Hoshin, PDCA/DMAIC etc.
  • Certificação Lean Practitioner e/ou Six Sigma Black Belt (Desejável)
  • Domínio avançado das ferramentas Lean e capacidade de ensinar metodologias.
  • Perfil de liderança, inspirando e motivando equipes.
  • Comunicação eficaz em todos os níveis (chão de fábrica até diretoria).
  • Atitude prática, energia e presença no chão de fábrica.
  • Habilidade como “embaixador da mudança”.
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais e domínio de MS Office.

description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations

  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

description:
About the job

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.

description:
A Ivy Group está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados com experiência sólida em Treasure Data (Customer Data Platform) para atuar em um de nossos clientes em um projeto estratégico focado na construção, evolução e ativação de pipelines de dados para diversos casos de uso de negócio, incluindo integração com Salesforce Marketing Cloud .


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar e otimizar pipelines de dados dentro do ecossistema Treasure Data , garantindo ingestão, qualidade, governança, segurança e ativação dos dados.
  • Desenvolver e manter fluxos de ingestão e transformação provenientes de múltiplas fontes, incluindo APIs, S3 e Fluentd .
  • Construir, evoluir e manter aplicações e processos responsáveis por tratamento, padronização e enriquecimento de dados.
  • Integrar o Treasure Data com Salesforce (Marketing Cloud, Sales e Service) para suportar jornadas, campanhas e outras ativações orientadas a dados.
  • Assegurar conformidade com diretrizes de segurança e privacidade (ex.: LGPD , políticas de consentimento, mascaramento de dados).
  • Planejar e executar estratégias de cutover entre ambientes (DEV/QA/PRD), garantindo estabilidade e continuidade operacional.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas e do cliente para entendimento de requisitos e entrega de soluções escaláveis e de alta performance.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada com Treasure Data , incluindo desenvolvimento, pipelines, workflows (Digdag), TD SQL e integrações.
  • Vivência em ingestão, transformação e tratamento de dados em plataformas de big data e CDPs.
  • Domínio de SQL avançado e experiência com Python para automações e transformações.
  • Conhecimento de práticas de DevOps/DataOps , incluindo Git, versionamento, automação e CI/CD .
  • Experiência com orquestração de pipelines (Digdag, Airflow).
  • Familiaridade com integrações de dados com Salesforce Marketing Cloud , Sales e Service Cloud é um diferencial relevante.


Modelo de Contratação e Informações

  • Modelo: PJ ou Cooperado
  • Formato: 100% remoto
  • Duração: 5 meses, com possibilidade de extensão conforme demanda do projeto
  • Atuação: Dedicação exclusiva em cliente da Ivy Group


Se você é Engenheiro(a) de Dados, possui experiência com Treasure Data e deseja atuar em um projeto relevante e com alto impacto, candidate-se e venha fazer parte desta oportunidade.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externa - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.


Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.


Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.


Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora, são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • Primam pela excelência na execução como forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem um ambiente inclusivo e um bom clima tanto para as pessoas que trabalham no Meli como para o negócio.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar na região da Baixada Fluminense - RJ


O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

description:
A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente:

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de indústria

• Experiência sólida com Java 8+ em ambientes corporativos.

• Domínio de frameworks como Spring, Spring Boot, Spring MVC.

• Experiência com servidores de aplicação: Tomcat, WildFly/JBoss ou equivalentes.

• Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST/SOAP.

• Manipulação de arquivos CSV, TXT, XML.

• Familiaridade com integrações legadas e arquiteturas híbridas.

• SQL avançado: joins complexos, triggers, views, procedures.
